about: The collision audit's CI limits, today's mode (the wild island with its hamlet: scripts/ark-collide-audit.mts --fixture --hours 2 --step 4; 6,526 animals, 4,432 measured, 7.6 M body samples), measured on ark-next (5cd8efff + the gate fixes, 2026-11-12), not on the lane's branch: the first limits (2,466 cliffs, 2,037,453 overlaps) were the branch's alone and never the merged tree's (L4's true sizes, L6's scenery, L3's perches, L1/L2/L7). Pass-throughs and fence crossings stay at 0. Cliffs: a walker on ground over twice as steep as its walk, read from the ground's own rise over a metre each way (the walk grid's measure; the shading normal's sub-metre detail read 3.3 on ground rising 0.25). Overlaps: mostly perched sleepers in shared tree crowns at night (recipe postures and sleep: eagles, hornbills and macaws in one crown), held where they perch; the merged tree's perches (L3/L6) put more of them in the same crowns. At most today's: a change that makes them worse fails the PR; a deliberate change updates them here, with why.
